description: This Java class defines the 'MappableOutboundSignal', representing an outbound signal that can be mapped with a specific PayloadMapping. It includes methods for retrieving the payload mapping, source signal, targets, converting to JSON, and standard object methods like equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: MappableOutboundSignal
classes.description: A final class representing an outbound signal that is ready to be mapped with a payload mapping, supporting JSON serialization and equality checks.

methods.name: getPayloadMapping
methods.description: Returns the PayloadMapping associated with this mappable outbound signal.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Retrieves the source Signal of this outbound signal.

methods.name: getTargets
methods.description: Returns the list of Target objects associated with this outbound signal.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the signal to a JsonObject using the specified schema version and predicate.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on delegate and payload mapping.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on delegate and payload mapping.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object including delegate and payload mapping details.
